title: Sharp Text
description: Keeps the UI and text at full 1080p while only the 3D scene is rendered at a lower resolution (Unity dynamic resolution). Switches a handheld run to the 1080p draw size, marks every non-UI camera as dynamic-resolution capable and calls ScalableBufferManager.ResizeBuffers with the chosen scene scale, so the text is no longer rasterised at 720p before MetalFX scales the picture. For Library of Ruina 1.0.3.

launcher.label: Sharp Text
launcher.note: Draws text and UI at full 1080p and only lowers the resolution of the game scene behind them. Best with Upscaling set to MetalFX. Switches Console mode to Docked sizes.

settings.label: Scene resolution
settings.note: Resolution of the game scene as a share of 1080p. 67 % is 720p, the same load as handheld mode.
